title: Add missing restart policies to docker-compose services
description:
**Severity: HIGH**

**File**: `docker-compose.yml`

**Bug**: `cordum-context-engine` (line 18), `cordum-workflow-engine` (line 107), and `cordum-dashboard` (line 127) lack `restart: unless-stopped`, while other services have it. Crashes in these services won't auto-recover in production.

**Fix**: Add `restart: unless-stopped` to all three services to match the pattern used by other services in the compose file.
definitionOfDone: All three services (context-engine, workflow-engine, dashboard) have restart: unless-stopped
All services in docker-compose.yml have consistent restart policies

implementationPlan.description: Add `restart: unless-stopped` to `cordum-context-engine` service (after line 18, matching the pattern used by cordum-safety-kernel and cordum-scheduler).
Add `restart: unless-stopped` to `cordum-api-gateway` service (after line 75 block — this service also lacks a restart policy).

Verify: run `docker compose config` to validate the compose file parses correctly. Confirm all Cordum application services have consistent restart policies (nats and redis are infrastructure and may intentionally differ).
